debug.changelog:
docs: normalize casing for technical terms in Russian translations

* docs: update `values-ru/strings.xml` to standardize the use of lowercase for technical abbreviations (vpn, doh, dns, dpi) and parenthetical descriptions
* docs: apply consistent lowercase formatting to obfuscation parameters, protocol identifiers, and system settings labels for better linguistic consistency across the UI
